plugins.name: website-testing-bot-plugin
plugins.description: Ultimate website testing bot providing exhaustive analysis of every site element including buttons, links, URLs, images, menus, forms, navigation, headers, footers, modals, tooltips, and interactive components. Performs comprehensive testing across functional validation, performance benchmarking, security auditing, accessibility compliance, SEO optimization, cross-browser compatibility, mobile responsiveness, load capacity estimation, and uniqueness scoring. Generates detailed commercial readiness grades with scaling predictions, uniqueness ratings against template detection, and overall readiness status classifications. Produces complete agent-handoff reports with explicit fix recommendations requiring zero assumptions about receiving agent knowledge. Tests every clickable element, validates all resource loading, checks broken links, verifies image optimization, assesses JavaScript functionality, evaluates CSS rendering, and stress-tests concurrent user capacity for production deployment sign-off.

grades.A+: Enterprise-ready: 100k+ concurrent users, <100ms response, zero critical issues
grades.A: Production-ready: 50k-100k users, <200ms response, no critical issues
grades.B+: Near-ready: 25k-50k users, <500ms response, minor issues only
grades.B: Viable: 10k-25k users, <1s response, some issues to address
grades.C+: Developing: 5k-10k users, acceptable performance, notable issues
grades.C: Early stage: 1k-5k users, performance concerns, multiple issues
grades.D: Not ready: <1k users, significant performance issues, many problems
grades.F: Critical: Fundamental issues preventing commercial use

thresholds.90-100: Highly Original - Custom design, unique functionality, strong brand identity
thresholds.75-89: Distinctive - Customized template with significant modifications
thresholds.50-74: Moderate - Recognizable template base with some customization
thresholds.25-49: Generic - Minimal template customization, common patterns
thresholds.1-24: Template Clone - Nearly unmodified template, no unique identity

statuses.READY: All critical tests pass, no blockers, approved for commercial launch
statuses.NEEDS_POLISHING: Functional but has issues requiring attention before launch
statuses.UNDER_CONSTRUCTION: Significant incomplete features or critical issues present
